title: Globestudio configuration
description: A Globestudio design: the file Export → Share → Export configuration saves, and the JSON a share link carries URL encoded in its ?c= parameter. It matches normalizeConfig in src/utils/share-config.js, which every link, embed and import goes through. Every key is optional, and the app drops any key or value this schema does not allow. In shaderSettings, globeSettings, spaceSettings and flowSettings, keys a config leaves out keep the values of the look the link opens on (/looks/<id>, or /embed with look=<id>), and get the app defaults on a link that names no look or a config that carries `version`. A link carries the config URL encoded in its address, and an embed address must stay under 32,000 characters, so a custom shape file or a long list of data points may not fit in an embed.

gradient.description: A 2 stop linear gradient, or null for none. Without both `from` and `to` it is dropped.

$schema.description: Exported files point here, so editors can check them.

version.description: Written by the app in every exported file and share link, where it marks a whole design: in shaderSettings, globeSettings, spaceSettings and flowSettings, keys the config leaves out get the app defaults, even on a look. Leave it out of a config that changes only some settings of a look. 2 also says the dot, map, grid, network, marker and flow colors render as their hex: the app writes 2 once a color is picked, and 1 for a design whose colors render darker than their hex, as every color did before.

v.description: Link format, only inside a ?c= payload. A payload without it, or with 1, is read the way links made before 2 were. With 3 the dot, map, grid, network, marker and flow colors render as their hex; with anything else they render darker than their hex, as they always have, unless the config carries version 2. The app writes 3 for a design with a picked color and 2 for the rest. Write 3 so the colors you set show as their hex.

selection.description: What the map shows: `world`, `country:` and an uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, `continent:` and a continent name, or `subregion:` and a subregion name. A lowercase code is dropped, and a name the app doesn't know shows the world.

stateSelection.description: When selection is `country:USA`, the state, DC or territory to show, by its postal code (`CA`) or its 2 digit FIPS code (`06`), or `all` for the whole country. The app stores the FIPS code, the id us-atlas gives the state. Any other value is dropped. The studio and embeds both draw the state.

backgroundStyle.description: `solid` paints a flat color; `space` paints a starfield-and-nebula scene; `flow` paints an animated gradient-mesh shader; `transparent` paints nothing and implies `transparent: true`.

density.description: Dot density across the visible area.

dotGradient.description: Gradient for the dots, used in place of `dotColor`.

dotRotation.description: Rotation of every dot, in degrees. The studio reads it; embeds draw every dot unrotated.

shapeRotationSpeed.description: Shape rotation speed from 0 to 100 (0 stops the animation).

asciiSymbol.description: Text drawn as each dot when `shape` is `ASCII`. Longer text is cut to 12 characters.

customShape.description: The image drawn as each dot when `shape` is `Custom`, or null. An SVG is cleaned of scripts and event handlers before use. The file rides in the link, so one of more than a few dozen kB won't fit in an embed address, which must stay under 32,000 characters.

name.description: File name. Longer names are cut to 80 characters.

dataUrl.description: The image as a data URL: base64 for PNG, JPEG and WebP, URL encoded markup for SVG.

svgSource.description: SVG only: the markup. When present the app reads it in place of `dataUrl`, which a custom shape still needs.

renderMode.description: `dots` draws the land as dots, `solid` as filled shapes.

worldFill.description: Land fill color in solid maps, as hex.

worldFillGradient.description: Gradient for the land fill, used in place of `worldFill`.

worldStroke.description: Outline color in solid maps, as hex.

worldStrokeGradient.description: Gradient for the outlines, used in place of `worldStroke`.

mapDepth.description: FOV-style depth for the 3D map view.

flatProjection.description: Projection for the flat map view. It applies to solid maps (renderMode "solid"); dotted maps always use Mercator.

citiesMinPop.description: Show only cities with at least this population.

shaderSettings.description: The shader pass. `effect` picks it; the other keys are knobs, and each effect reads only some of them.

globeSettings.description: 3D globe chrome: auto-spin, glow halo, grid mesh, network arcs, data markers.

autoSpin.description: Legacy field. The current control is `autoSpinSpeed` (0 to 100, where 0 stops the spin); when this is `false` on import, autoSpinSpeed is forced to 0.

autoSpinSpeed.description: Globe auto-rotation speed from 0 to 100 (0 stops the spin).

dotLift.description: How far the dots sit above the sphere.

glowColor.description: Hex color for the glow halo. null picks one from the look and the dot color.

gridColor.description: Solid tint for all grid lines unless gridGradient is set.

gridGradient.description: Gradient for the grid lines, by latitude (south → north).

gridLift.description: How far the grid lines sit above the sphere.

networkArcs.description: Arc density from 0 to 100, or legacy bool (true = default density, false = hidden).

networkPulses.description: Pulse density from 0 to 100, or legacy bool (true = default density, false = hidden).

arcColor.description: Hex string. Uniform tint for all network arc lines/trails/heads. null falls back to per-route hardcoded polychrome.

pulseColor.description: Hex string. Uniform tint for all city pulse cores + rings. null falls back to per-hub hardcoded polychrome.

networkMono.description: Deprecated. Was the polychrome/mono toggle for network rendering. Ignored. Use arcColor / pulseColor instead.

routes.description: Route lines, drawn with the borderless look only.

surfaceColor.description: Solid tint for the sphere fill unless surfaceGradient is set.

surfaceGradient.description: Gradient for the sphere fill, by latitude (south → north).

data.description: Show the pasted data markers and their arcs. false hides them but keeps dataPoints.

dataPoints.description: Data markers, one per point, sized by value. The Data paste box writes this. Points with a missing or out of range lat or lng are dropped, and only the first 250 valid points are kept.

value.description: Sets the marker size. Missing or not a number reads as 1.

dataArcs.description: Draw an arc from each data point to the next, in list order. Needs at least 2 points; arcs show in globe view only.

dataMarkerColor.description: Hex color for the data markers and their arcs. null uses the default cyan (#7edfff).

spaceSettings.description: Starfield + nebula tuning. Applies when backgroundStyle is `space`.

flowSettings.description: Animated gradient-mesh tuning. Applies when backgroundStyle is `flow`.
